title: Audit-trigger P0001 'audit_entries is immutable' guard fires 6× alongside missing source_ref column
notes: WF-03 Step 1 diagnosis (run WF03-gh389-20260802) determined the handoff hypothesis was incorrect: (a) src/db/audit.zig and src/events/store.zig do not exist; actual files are src/obs/audit.zig and src/event_store/store.zig. (b) migrations/GBL-102_audit_immutability.sql and GBL-103_audit_immutability_guard.sql do not exist; the actual audit immutability migrations are 020_obs03_audit_entries.sql and 051_xc02_audit_immutability.sql. (c) source_ref column does NOT exist in event_store — it is on dead_letter_queue (added by 021_obs05_dead_letter_context.sql, preserved through the 072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql rename to dead_letter_items). (d) Tests iss202 / iss203 / iss205 do NOT reference source_ref; their failures are unrelated infrastructure drift (FK on variable_schemas, check constraint on webhook_deliveries, DebugAllocator leaks). The actual root cause is a production-code / migration name mismatch: src/dlq/store.zig and the DLQ integration tests still INSERT/SELECT against `dead_letter_queue` (old name from migration 006) while migration 072 renamed the canonical table to `dead_letter_items`. In the active test database, the relation targeted has only the pre-021 columns (no source_ref, no item_type) so PostgreSQL returns C42703 on every INSERT. Separately, tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig lines 427-449 install trg_bpm_test_fail_audit_insert WITHOUT a savepoint wrapper, and the cleanup defer at 448-449 only runs on the happy path; the trigger then leaks into neighbouring tests (adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain_test, oidc16_26_agent_lifecycle_foundations_test) where it fires P0001 audit_entries is immutable via bpm_audit_immutable_guard (migrations/020_obs03_audit_entries.sql:48) and bpm_audit_on_mutation (line 43). Full diagnosis: docs/issue-reports/ISS-0123-root-cause.yaml.

root_cause.details: Two intertwined issues, both rooted in DLQ subsystem: (A) Cluster B / C42703 — src/dlq/store.zig and tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig + obs06_alerts_test.zig reference the legacy table name `dead_letter_queue` (lines 148, 262, 361, 408, 416, 428, 461, 511, 625, 691, 746 in store.zig; lines 33, 37, 73, 234, 344, 357, 459 in obs05_dlq_test.zig; lines 32, 56 in obs06_alerts_test.zig). Migration 072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql renamed that table to `dead_letter_items` but the production code path and tests were never updated. Where the test database's search_path routes through a relation with the pre-021 column set, the INSERT against source_ref / item_type fails with PostgreSQL C42703 (undefined_column). (B) Cluster A / P0001 — tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig:TC-OBS-05-INT-01 lines 427-449 deliberately install trg_bpm_test_fail_audit_insert BEFORE-INSERT trigger on audit_entries to verify that handleDiscard returns HTTP 500. The cleanup defer at line 448-449 only executes if the test's main flow reaches end-of-function; the trigger persists in db_test across test processes and leaks into adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain_test:TC-ADP-09-01 and oidc16_26_agent_lifecycle_foundations_test:TC-OIDC-22-01 where it fires P0001 audit_entries is immutable via bpm_audit_immutable_guard (migrations/020_obs03_audit_entries.sql:48) and bpm_audit_on_mutation (line 43).

candidate_resolution: 1. Production-code rename: change every `dead_letter_queue` reference in src/dlq/store.zig (11 occurrences across lines 148, 262, 361, 408, 416, 428, 461, 511, 625, 691, 746) to `dead_letter_items` to match the canonical name from migration 072. 2. Test-fixture rename: change `dead_letter_queue` to `dead_letter_items` in tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig (lines 33, 37, 73, 234, 344, 357, 459) and tests/integration/obs06_alerts_test.zig (lines 32, 56). 3. Test isolation: wrap trg_bpm_test_fail_audit_install/uninstall inside a savepoint or an unconditional defer that runs even on early return; verify cleanup runs at start of the next test. 4. Infra reconciliation: verify the test database's dead_letter_items table has source_ref / item_type columns; if a stale public.dead_letter_queue still exists with the pre-021 column set (GBL-073 migration_window_active was TRUE), drop it via zig build migrate after setting the window flag to FALSE.
resolution: Implemented fix on feature/WF03-gh389-20260802: renamed dead_letter_queue → dead_letter_items across 22 source/test files, wrapped obs05 trigger install in SAVEPOINT with errdefer ROLLBACK, added tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py linter, added tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig regression test. Validated: zig build/test/migrate all exit 0, 2/2 iss0123 tests pass, 14/14 TM tests pass.
prevention: Add a lint that scans src/ and tests/integration/ for references to legacy table names (dead_letter_queue, form_schema_registry, audit_log) and fails the build if any hit is found outside migrations/ and design/.

Mandatory invariant for integration tests: any CREATE TRIGGER / CREATE FUNCTION inside an integration test must be paired with a defer at the top of the test body (not at the bottom) so cleanup runs even on early return.
Run information_schema.columns introspection on dead_letter_items as part of TestHarness.init() and fail-fast if source_ref is missing.
Run tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py in zig build pre-test step to catch schema-name drift before tests run.
